rows: What counts as a good solution
Key terms shift meaning (mass in Newton vs. Einstein)
Disciplinary matrix (all shared beliefs/values) or more specifically an exemplar (concrete problem-solution teaching the community's methods)
Puzzle-solving within the paradigm; not testing it, extending and applying it
When anomalies accumulate, resist solution despite sustained effort, and strike at the paradigm's core
Paradigm replacement: gestalt switch, new ontology, new exemplars, changed meaning of key terms
Pre- and post-revolution paradigms lack common measure; partial untranslatability of key terms
Kuhn says no — values like accuracy/consistency persist; choice requires judgment, not mob rule
How does Kuhn differ from Popper?
Kuhn: descriptive, historical; scientists protect paradigms rationally. Popper: normative; scientists should seek falsification
